We've got a scheduled reactor batch today, and the packaging area and utilities workshop also rely on chilled water. I'd like to get a temporary cooling plan in place, but per our standard practice, we need to run a single pre-work review covering process, maintenance, and environmental health and safety findings before we set up any temporary connections. Can I get input from each of those areas so we can document the plan and required controls and get temporary cooling online as safely and quickly as possible?
